newsitem.title: USA: NRG plans to seek acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: NRG plans to seek acquisitions.

text.p: NRG Generating (U.S.) Inc said Wednesday it will seek acquisitions of operating power and co-generation plants and will consider taking over competitors.
In a statement released after the company's annual meeting, NRG said it also plans to focus on the U.S. energy market for the near term, including customers in the Northeast, Midwest and Southeast.

NRG, an electricity and thermal energy producer, said it will target projects that sell a portion of energy output to large industrial customers. It also will pursue technology related to gas turbines.
The company is 42-percent owned by NRG Energy Inc, which is a subsidiary of Northern States Power Co.
Last month, the company named Robert Sherman Jr as its new president and chief executive.

"The combined talents of NRG Generating and NRG Energy will allow us jointly to compete aggressively for new facilties, acquire new plants and companies, and, as our stock grows in value, to access public equity capital markets," Sherman said in the company's statement.
